recipe.animations_off.title: Turn off animations
recipe.animations_off.summary: Removes system animations. The interface responds instantly.
recipe.animations_halved.title: Halve animations
recipe.animations_halved.summary: Shortens animation duration without removing them.
recipe.disable_window_blur.title: Remove window blur
recipe.disable_window_blur.summary: Avoids the GPU cost of blur on Android 12 and later.
recipe.clear_background_activities.title: Close background apps
recipe.clear_background_activities.summa: Frees CPU and memory from processes you are not using.
recipe.force_doze.title: Force Doze mode
recipe.force_doze.summary: Suspends background processes to save battery and CPU.
recipe.trim_caches.title: Trim system cache
recipe.trim_caches.summary: Asks the system to free cached space without deleting your data.
recipe.clear_logcat.title: Clear logs
recipe.reduce_logcat_buffer.title: Shrink log buffer
recipe.reduce_logcat_buffer.summary: Limits the memory the system spends on logs.
recipe.location_off.title: Turn off location
recipe.location_off.summary: Disables GPS and constant location scanning.
recipe.assist_gesture_off.title: Disable assistant gesture
recipe.assist_gesture_off.summary: Disables the shortcut that launches the assistant and uses memory.
recipe.haptic_feedback_off.title: Disable haptic feedback
recipe.touch_sounds_off.title: Mute touch sounds
recipe.touch_sounds_off.summary: Stops playing a sound on every interaction.
recipe.screensaver_off.title: Disable screen saver
recipe.screensaver_off.summary: Stops the TV from running the screen saver while idle.
recipe.tv_fixed_performance.title: Fixed performance mode
recipe.tv_fixed_performance.summary: Keeps clocks high on supported TVs. Uses more power.

apps.title: Installed apps
launcher.title: System launcher
launcher.warning: Install a launcher APK as a regular app to verify its package and, if the device allows writing to /system, turn it into the system launcher and default Home.
launcher.installFailed: Android did not confirm APK installation.
launcher.installed: APK installed. Review the detected package and choose the system target.
launcher.noCompatibleHome: Install an APK that declares a MAIN/HOME activity. If the manufacturer restricts launchers, Android may prevent selecting it.
launcher.systemWarning: Copies the APK to /system, reboots, sets it as Home and, only after verification, disables the previous launcher. Requires adb root or su (Magisk/KernelSU).
launcher.noSystemAccess: This device does not allow writing to /system. Check the Root tab for an access diagnosis.
launcher.unsupported: Device without /system access. Nothing was modified.
launcher.installCompleted: Launcher installed to /system, set as Home and the previous one was disabled.
launcher.activated: The launcher is active as Home and the previous one was disabled.
launcher.rollbackStarted: Rollback requested; the device will reboot.
root.title: Root and /system access
root.warning: This panel does not exploit the device: it uses `adb root` (userdebug/eng builds) or an already installed `su` (Magisk, KernelSU, SuperSU). On retail TVs with a locked bootloader there is no way to write to /system with ADB alone.
root.noRoot: No root available. This device would need a userdebug/eng build or Magisk with an unlocked bootloader; it cannot be done over ADB alone.
root.howDebug: 1. userdebug/eng build: enable USB debugging and press “Enable adb root”, then “Remount /system RW”.
root.howMagisk: 2. If Magisk/KernelSU is already installed: press “Check su” and accept the prompt on the device screen.
root.howRetail: 3. Locked retail TV: you must unlock the bootloader (wipes data, vendor-specific), patch boot.img with Magisk and flash it. This app does not exploit the device and cannot do it over ADB alone.
root.convertWarning: Moves a user app's APK to /system. The user copy is kept so the app keeps working; the system copy survives a factory reset.
root.convertConfirm: {pkg} will be copied to {target} and the device will reboot. Continue?
root.convertDone: {pkg} was copied to {target}. The user app is still installed.
systemApp.title: Convert app to system
recipe.bg_dexopt_job.title: Optimize app code
recipe.bg_dexopt_job.summary: Runs Android background dex optimization. It can take several minutes and is not reverted from here.
recipe.cached_apps_freezer.title: Freeze cached apps
recipe.cached_apps_freezer.summary: Freezes cached processes to free RAM without closing your apps. Requires Android 11 or newer.
recipe.adaptive_sleep_off.title: Turn off screen attention
recipe.adaptive_sleep_off.summary: Prevents the camera from keeping the screen on while you look at it. Saves battery.
recipe.auto_brightness_off.title: Turn off auto brightness
recipe.auto_brightness_off.summary: Locks the current brightness and avoids constant sensor adjustments. May require manual tuning.
recipe.restrict_background_data.title: Restrict background data
recipe.restrict_background_data.summary: WARNING: saves battery and data, but may interrupt notifications, sync and updates.
recipe.reduce_resolution_720p.title: Reduce resolution to 720p
recipe.reduce_resolution_720p.summary: WARNING: improves performance on slow devices, but the image will look blurrier. It can be restored.
recipe.reduce_density_160.title: Reduce screen density
recipe.reduce_density_160.summary: WARNING: shows more content, but some elements may look small or misaligned. It can be restored.
recipe.cap_refresh_60.title: Cap refresh rate at 60 Hz
recipe.cap_refresh_60.summary: Reduces display power use on 90/120 Hz devices. May lower visual smoothness.
recipe.wanboos_launcher.title: Install system launcher
recipe.wanboos_launcher.summary: Turns a launcher into a system app on any device with /system write access, sets it as Home and disables the previous Home. Requires root and rollback available.
flash.title: Image flashing and Magisk
flash.warning: Flashing a boot partition can leave the device unbootable. Keep a backup and use images from the exact firmware for your model. Everything runs over USB; fastboot does not work over Wi-Fi.
flash.backupWarning: Keep a copy of boot/init_boot before touching anything. The backup is downloaded to the machine running this app.
flash.magiskSteps: Install the official Magisk app and open it. In Magisk: Install → Select and patch a file → choose boot.img (or init_boot). Magisk does not ship a headless PC patcher: patching happens on the device.
flash.magiskOpened: Magisk opened on the device. Follow the app steps.
flash.noImages: No .img files in /sdcard/Download. Patch boot.img in Magisk and search again.
flash.flashWarning: The device will reboot to the bootloader and the selected partition will be written. Double-check model, partition and slot.
flash.confirmMismatch: Name does not match. Type exactly “{device}”.
flash.rootMissing: Magisk did not answer as root. Open the app and finish setup.
